sentences.en: One cannot judge people only by their outward appearances.
sentences.zh: 仅凭外表不能评判一个人。

sentences.en: Those who look outward dream, but those who look inward awaken.
sentences.zh: 向外看的人在做梦，向内看的人在觉醒。

sentences.en: The universe is still growing outward in every direction.
sentences.zh: 宇宙仍在每一个方向向外扩展。

senses.zh: 向外的；外面的；公开的；外服的；肉体的
向外（等于outwards）；在外；显而易见地
